Most health insurance claims in India get rejected, so why pay for a policy

According to IRDAI Annual Report 2024–25, as reported by IndiaMedToday, 87% of health claims were settled and only 8% were rejected. Cafemutual reported in Jan 2026 that about 41% of health complaints taken to the Insurance Ombudsman were resolved in the policyholder’s favour. Does that change how you view the likelihood of a claim being rejected?
Are you sure? I read most claims get rejected.

The IRDAI data shows 87% of claims were settled, and the Insurance Ombudsman awarded the policyholder in about 52% of health complaints (Council for Insurance Ombudsmen, Annual Report 2023‑24). Also, insurers met the 1‑hour cashless decision target for 86.9% of requests (Lok Sabha Starred Question, 1 Dec 2025). Does that affect your view on claim rejections?
